segments.caption: The camera slowly pans across a rugged, sunlit rock formation, revealing a dark, shadowed crevice or cave entrance nestled between the jagged stones. The main event is the steady, deliberate movement toward this mysterious opening, emphasizing the contrast between the bright, textured rock surfaces and the deep, unknown darkness within.
The camera slowly pans forward through a narrow, rocky crevice, revealing a dark, shadowy opening ahead, suggesting the entrance to a cave or tunnel.
A large tour bus, marked with the number 803 and the word "CHARTERED," carefully navigates through a narrow, rocky mountain pass, emerging from a dark tunnel into bright daylight.
A Stagecoach Western charter bus, numbered 803, slowly and steadily drives through a narrow, rocky mountain tunnel, its front end emerging from the dark passage into bright daylight.

A Stagecoach West bus, numbered 803, is shown navigating a narrow, rocky pass, with its front end pressed tightly between two cliff faces. The vehicle appears to be stuck or deliberately maneuvering through a very tight spot, with the driver visible inside the cab. The frames capture the precarious situation from various angles, highlighting the bus’s struggle to pass through the constricted canyon-like passage.

A large coach bus is shown precariously perched on the edge of a steep, rocky cliff, with its front end hanging over the drop. The vehicle appears to have veered off a narrow road and is now dangerously balanced. Inside, a driver is visible, seemingly in the process of attempting to control or exit the vehicle. The camera pans around the bus, showing the extreme angle and the precarious position, before focusing on the side of the bus as it begins to tip

A white Stagecoach West bus, numbered 803, is shown stuck nose-first in a narrow, rocky canyon pass, with its front end wedged between towering rock walls. A man in an orange shirt stands nearby, observing the predicament. The sequence captures the moment the bus becomes immobilized, highlighting the dangerous, confined terrain and the resulting vehicle entrapment.
A white Stagecoach West bus, numbered 803, carefully navigates a narrow, winding road through a rocky canyon, with passengers and other vehicles visible nearby.
